## Validation

## Security and privacy

- [ ] No credentials, tokens, health payloads, routes, or photo data enter logs
- [ ] New permissions are requested only at point of use
- [ ] Sensitive local data uses an appropriate protection class

- [ ] Third-party Actions and dependencies are pinned and reviewed
